brief.label: Harborview brief
brief.text:
Harborview Credit Union: request for a lighting retrofit
Job: 12-branch lighting retrofit
Scope: LED lighting retrofit and panel labeling at each branch. One crew-week per branch.
Budget ceiling: $180,000 for the whole program.
Branch access windows (the branch is closed to the public only during its window):
S01 Oakridge, S02 Millbrook, S03 Harbor Point, S04 Linden: Nov 2 to Nov 6.
S05 Westfield, S06 Cypress Row, S07 Northgate, S08 Fairview: Nov 9 to Nov 13.
S09 Sunset Park, S10 Riverside, S11 Elm Court, S12 Bayshore: Nov 16 to Nov 20.
Payment: 30% on award, balance net 30 after final sign-off.
The customer must approve the fixture schedule before work starts.

alder.label: Alder quote
alder.text:
From: Alder Line Electric
Quote for the Harborview 12-branch lighting retrofit.
Price: $12,000 per branch, up to 6 branches.
Availability: 2 branches in week 1, 2 branches in week 2, 2 branches in week 3.
Terms: 20% advance, balance net 30 after each branch sign-off. Paid by Brightline Electrical.
Excludes permits. Quote valid until 2026-12-31.
